items.rationale: Fitting for repair of the failed heating pipe; covered as repair material under 7.1.7(c). 4 pcs at about 9 EUR each.
Repair fitting under 7.1.7(c), but the replaced pipe is 15mm, so 28mm fittings risk a mismatch under 7.1.8(e). 5 pcs at about 20 EUR each.
Same dimension-mismatch risk as line 2 under 7.1.8(e); otherwise repair material. 1 pc at about 20 EUR.
Minor fixings count as consumable installation material under 7.1.7(c). 8 pcs, small amount.
Fixings for the repaired pipe under 7.1.7(c). 4 pcs at about 5 EUR each.
Replacement section of the failed heating pipe, like-for-like copper. 6.4 m at about 15 EUR/m.
Repair labour under 7.1.7(g). Price prior gives about 566 EUR for 6.75 hrs; trimmed slightly since some time likely went on the uncovered extra jobs.
Labour under 7.1.7(g), though the hours may partly relate to the uncovered maintenance jobs. 5.75 hrs at about 55 EUR/hr.
Re-insulation of the repaired pipe, matching the pre-loss standard. Price prior about 146 EUR for 6 pcs.
Fastening for the insulation, a consumable under 7.1.7(c). 2 kg is plentiful, so the amount is kept modest.
Lump-sum consumables are not excluded merely for being invoiced as a lump sum under 7.1.8(e)/7.1.7(c). Kept modest.
One travel or call-out charge per contractor per invoice is covered under 7.1.7(f). Prior about 80 EUR.
Debris removal from the repair is covered under 5.2.1/7.1.8(a), but waste may come mainly from the laminate removal. Prior about 62 EUR.

items.description: Repainting basement hallway outside boiler room
items.rationale: Hallway was not affected by the escaping water, so excluded under 7.1.5 and 3.5.
Room was not affected by the leak; this is maintenance, excluded under 7.1.5 and 7.1.8(a).
Routine maintenance with no insured damage, excluded under 7.1.8(a).
Administrative and processing charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
